_comment: Curated metadata per commit, keyed by short SHA. Everything else in the Change Log is generated from git. See docs/CHANGE_MANAGEMENT.md. Add an entry here whenever a meaningful change ships; commits with no entry still appear, with blank Detail/Risk/Verification/Rollback.

_versions._comment: commit SHA -> release version it shipped in. Earliest commit of a version anchors it; later commits inherit the most recent version at or before them.

e03e427.detail: Reworked the e-commerce CSV import so a re-uploaded month closes stock-out gaps without double-counting sales. Sale keys and deduction keys are tracked separately per Order_ID|SKU.
e03e427.verification: Re-uploaded a full month and confirmed sales count unchanged while missing deductions were filled.
e03e427.rollback: git revert e03e427; previously-repaired Inventory_Out rows must be deleted by Reference_ID.

6c70af4.detail: Dashboard analytics: profit and margin, period-over-period trends, channel split and weekly online performance.
6c70af4.verification: Cross-checked profit and margin against the finance tracker workbook for the same period.
6c70af4.rollback: git revert 6c70af4 — read-only dashboard code, no stored data affected.

58498ea.detail: Offline income rows that carry no COGS are excluded from the margin ratio, so margin is not inflated by costless income.
58498ea.verification: Margin recomputed with and without offline income; difference matched the offline income total.

b7ab923.detail: Historical offline income import, wired into the dashboard cashflow.
b7ab923.verification: Imported totals reconciled against the historical income tracker.
b7ab923.rollback: git revert b7ab923; delete OFFIN-* rows from the Offline_Income sheet.

8d6abb8.detail: Dividend and investment give-back payouts no longer count as operating expense or cashflow.
8d6abb8.verification: Expense total before/after compared against the categorized expense list.
